name: ConnectFor
description:
ConnectFor – your most-trusted online volunteering platform. Find an NGO to volunteer with through ConnectFor.
ConnectFor aims to be an all encompassing resource solution for NGOs; it seeks to help and develop the culture of volunteering across India, encouraging both individuals and organisations to realise how to best use volunteering opportunities to add the most value.
ConnectFor works with 650+ NGOs across 12 different cause areas including environment, animals, children & youth, education & literacy etc. The goal of ConnectFor is to make the right volunteer "connections" so that it is #WinWinForACause.
ConnectFor works with individual volunteers and corporate/group volunteers.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Todur
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an incredible experience with ConnectFor! Their platform is user-friendly, making it easy to find volunteering opportunities that match my interests. The variety of causes and projects available is impressive, ensuring there's something for everyone.

ConnectFor's seamless matching process connects volunteers with relevant nonprofits, and the communication between both parties is efficient and effective. The transparency provided about each organization's mission and impact is commendable, helping me make informed decisions about where to volunteer.

The support team at ConnectFor is responsive and helpful, addressing any queries or concerns promptly. Their dedication to facilitating meaningful connections is evident in every interaction.

Overall, ConnectFor has transformed the volunteering experience for everyone, making it effortless and rewarding. I highly recommend ConnectFor to anyone looking to make a difference and connect with inspiring nonprofits.

name: NGO in Mumbai | Food Donation - AkshayaChaitanya
description:
Akshaya Chaitanya is a NGO in Mumbai with the objective to donate food in a sustainable and scalable way. It is an initiative of HKM Charitable Foundation striving to provide food relief to marginalised sections of the society in the city of Mumbai.
3 key Food Donation Programmes:
Bal Shiksha Ahara - Government School Breakfast food donation Initiative giving nutritious breakfast meals to fight classroom hunger
Swasthya Ahara - Government hospital food donation initiative for unlimited, nutritious lunch to patient's family to keep them healthy and helps save for medication
Paushtik Ahara - Meals on wheels initiative Providing free, unlimited, nutritious lunch combined with education prepares children in slum areas for a bright future

featured_reviews.name: ankita mulchandani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I, Dr. Ankita Mulchandani, had attended your eye camp in lifeline express held at Siddharth Nagar from 21st January, 2023 to 27th January, 2023.
I had worked from morning to evening, I had diligently seen the OPD and done surgeries as were assigned to me by the authorities at the location.

I would like to bring to your notice that on the last day before leaving, I was asked to sign on a voucher of INR 70,000 for my services but I have received only INR 36,000 via NEFT.
On asking the authorities about the same they disconnected my innumerable calls and blocked my number.

I feel very insulted by this behaviour of members of your organisation and I can only imagine that if a surgeon is being treated like this, how the unaffordable patients must be treated!
This behaviour does not reflect well on the credibility of the organisation.

featured_reviews.name: Ashna Durrani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing and irresponsible response.
I contacted this rescue because they were the closest to my location—just a 17-minute ride away. I called them multiple times, and my dad also personally called and spoke to them. We were assured that something would be done.

The first call was made at 1:08 PM. It is now 4:50 PM, and there has been absolutely no response or sign of help. We waited for hours, hoping for a reply. Sadly, the dog is no longer breathing.

This kind of negligence is unacceptable from an organization that claims to rescue animals. Because of this experience, we will be leaving very negative reviews and strongly urge others to reconsider relying on this service in emergencies.

featured_reviews.name: Ankita Raut
featured_reviews.review_text: Thank You Team for saving 1 street cats life. I saw 1 severely injured cat in my area. His intestines were hanging out due to big cut on his stomach. We thought he will die and there were no chances of survival in this case. But you guys saved his life. Around 35,000 cost incurred in his operation, but you guys did it in free of cost and did not take any money from our side. 🙏🏻 Again thank you so much for your amazing work for saving such homeless animals life and giving them 2nd life.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you so much for your kind words and for sharing this touching story.
We remember this case well, and we’re truly grateful you reached out in time—it was your quick action that gave him a fighting chance.

Seeing him survive such a critical injury reminds us why we do what we do. Every life matters, and your appreciation means the world to us.

Thank you for trusting us, and for caring so deeply for the voiceless. 🐾🙏🏻
— Team Sherry & Diya Foundation
It was a challenging case, but we believe every life matters—especially the voiceless ones who rely on us. We’re overjoyed to know he's recovering and has been given a second chance.

Your compassion and timely action made all the difference. Thank you for trusting us. Together, we can keep making this world kinder for animals. 🐾✨

— Team Sherry & Diya Foundation
